content: NSwag generates full runtime C#/TypeScript HTTP client classes (heavier, more code, targets OpenAPI 3.0) with MSBuild/CLI build integration; openapi-typescript+openapi-fetch instead emits types-only definitions with a tiny fetch wrapper (near-zero runtime cost), and pairs naturally with Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi's native OpenAPI 3.1 output (better nullability fidelity than NSwag's 3.0 target). For a project already using Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi + Swashbuckle and valuing small bundles, openapi-typescript is the better fit; NSwag is preferable only if a full-featured generated client (e.g. C# client for another .NET consumer) is required.
